name: Canoe Place Inn & Cottages
aliases: Good Ground Tavern at Canoe Place
description: A restored historic inn in Hampton Bays with cottages, the Good Ground Tavern restaurant, a garden and a ballroom. It hosts Wednesday evening music in the garden, such as acoustic sets and jazz trios, plus other special events.

dancing.notes: Public music nights take place in the garden with lounge seating and fire pits, and they are set up for relaxing and listening. The inn has a ballroom and offers DJ dance after-parties in the Study for weddings, but we found no public dance nights.

evidence.note: Venue event page for Autumn Acoustics: live acoustic music in the garden by the fire pits on Wednesdays, 5 to 8 PM.
Venue page for an earlier Wednesday Jazz in the Garden series with rotating jazz trios, including Latin jazz nights; no tickets or reservations needed.
Weddings page describes ballroom receptions and an after-party option with a DJ in the Study for dancing (private events only).
Listing for the 2026 Summer Sounds series: Wednesday garden concerts with lounge seating from June 24 to September 2.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05) for source canoe-place-inn-cottages-hampton-bays. Event listings use the names of spaces inside the inn (garden, Study, Good Ground Tavern, front courtyard); these are saved as aliases.
